description: Verify a spec's requirements are claimed by issues, pull requests, or code, from caller-supplied requirement and claim facts. Returns covered and uncovered requirements, dangling claims that name no requirement, per-requirement claim counts, and a verdict. Nothing is fetched.

claims.description: Claims that an issue, pull request, or code reference addresses a requirement

requirement_id.description: Id of the requirement being claimed

source_ref.description: Reference to the claiming source, e.g. an issue number or a file path

name: check_spec_coverage
